items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Fernandez used to play with him, Alvin Fernandez. Yeah, yeah, I remember Alvin. [INTERVIEWEE] What happened to him?

ctx.x: Yeah, see, Alvin's with them. Yeah. They play that Dixon man? Yeah. Oh, strictly Dixon man. Yeah.
Yeah, Fernandez used to play with him, Alvin Fernandez. Yeah, yeah, I remember Alvin.
